scope: The exact 13 free-tool URLs from the Flaq AI source README. Same-company directory, not an independent ranking.

tools.name: VideoWeb AI
tools.description: Opening shots, transitions and camera studies for filmmakers and marketers. Use a short take to decide whether the framing communicates the scene before planning a longer sequence.
tools.description_zh: 适合开场、转场和运镜试拍。先用一个短镜头看清构图和动作，再决定是否扩展成完整片段。
tools.caution: Do not assume the broader model demos use the free form’s settings.
tools.caution_zh: 页面中的模型演示不代表免费表单的输出规格。
tools.title: A warm room reveal
tools.prompt: From a still view outside an open wooden doorway, slowly push the camera into a quiet reading room. A curtain moves gently at the window. End with the chair and lamp fully visible. Keep the doorway straight and the room layout unchanged. Soft room tone; no dialogue or text.
tools.review: doorway geometry and a steady camera path
tools.review_zh: 门框是否变形、运镜是否平稳
tools.evidence_method: Public HTML and rendered browser form; screenshot saved
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: Each free video is generated at 480p with a 5-second duration.
tools.prompt_zh: 从敞开的木门外缓慢推进安静的阅读室，窗帘在窗边轻轻移动。结束时完整展示椅子和台灯。门框保持笔直，房间布局不变。轻微室内环境声，不要对白或文字。

tools.name: MusicMaker
tools.description: A music-focused platform for cover animation, release teasers and visual backgrounds. Create a short visual, download it, then cut it against your own track in an editor.
tools.description_zh: 适合动态封面、新歌预告和音乐视频背景。先生成短片，再下载到剪辑软件中与自己的音乐组合。
tools.caution: The free tool does not automatically synchronize clips to your uploaded song.
tools.caution_zh: 免费工具不等于上传歌曲后自动卡点或生成完整音乐视频。
tools.title: Cover-art atmosphere
tools.prompt: A fictional cobalt record sleeve stands on a desk beside a clear glass prism. Hold the camera still as a narrow band of sunlight crosses the sleeve, then settles on the prism. Preserve the sleeve shape and blank cover. Gentle room ambience; no lyrics or text.
tools.review: stable cover edges; add the actual track afterwards
tools.review_zh: 封面边缘是否稳定；实际歌曲后期添加
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: Create five-second, 480p clips with generated audio in 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1.
tools.prompt_zh: 一个虚构的钴蓝色唱片封套立在桌上，旁边放着透明玻璃棱镜。固定镜头，一条窄阳光缓慢扫过封套，最后停在棱镜上。封套保持原有形状，封面留白。轻微室内环境声，不要歌词或文字。

tools.name: UGC Maker
tools.description: A creator-oriented workspace for product demonstrations and short social concepts. Test an opening action, such as turning on a lamp, before developing an ad script.
tools.description_zh: 适合产品演示和社交短片创意。先测试打开台灯这样的开场动作，再扩写广告脚本。
tools.caution: A generated performance is not a real customer testimonial.
tools.caution_zh: 生成的人物表演不能当作真实用户证言。
tools.title: Desk lamp demo
tools.prompt: In a fixed medium shot of a clean desk, an adult hand presses the switch of a small matte desk lamp once. The lamp turns on and casts a warm pool of light across a blank notebook. Hold the final state. Keep the hand natural and the lamp shape fixed. One soft click, no speech.
tools.review: finger contact, one switch press and light direction
tools.review_zh: 手指接触、单次按键和光线方向
tools.evidence_method: Rendered browser page and expanded output FAQ
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: The free MiniMax H3 workflow creates five-second, 480p clips in 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1, with built-in AI audio.
tools.prompt_zh: 固定中景展示整洁桌面，一只成年人的手只按一次哑光台灯开关。灯亮起，在空白笔记本上投下暖色光斑，最后保持亮灯状态。手部自然，灯的形状不变。只听见轻微开关声，不要对白。

tools.name: HeyDream
tools.description: A general creative suite for exploring scene ideas from text or a pair of endpoint images. Useful when the next decision is a composition or transition rather than a finished film.
tools.description_zh: 从文字或首尾两张图片探索场景。适合先确定构图、动作和转场，再制作完整视频。
tools.caution: Two endpoints guide a transition; they do not guarantee exact frame preservation.
tools.caution_zh: 首尾帧提供方向，但不保证逐像素还原。
tools.title: Paper boat storyboard
tools.prompt: A small yellow paper boat rests in a shallow puddle on a quiet courtyard floor. A faint breeze moves it slowly from left to right. Keep the camera at puddle level and stop the movement before the frame edge. Preserve the folded paper shape. Light water sounds, no music or text.
tools.review: boat shape and consistent screen direction
tools.evidence_method: Rendered browser page and expanded output FAQ
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: Free MiniMax H3 creates five-second, 480p clips in 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1.
tools.prompt_zh: 安静院落的浅水洼里漂着一只黄色小纸船。微风让纸船缓慢从左向右移动，在画面边缘之前停下。镜头贴近水面且保持不动。纸船折叠形状不变。轻微水声，不要音乐或文字。

tools.name: Flaq AI
tools.description: A browser H3 entry point on a platform that also offers model APIs. Use the free page to compare two wording choices before considering a separate developer integration.
tools.description_zh: 可先用免费网页比较两种提示词写法，再考虑单独的模型接口集成。适合快速验证产品展示和视听场景创意。
tools.caution: Free browser access does not include free API usage.
tools.caution_zh: 免费网页生成不等于免费调用接口。
tools.title: Single-variable light test
tools.prompt: One unbranded white ceramic cup sits on a dark tabletop. With a locked camera, move a soft highlight slowly from the left rim to the right rim. The cup never rotates. End with the whole cup visible. Quiet studio ambience; no text or speech.
tools.review: whether lighting changes without changing cup geometry
tools.review_zh: 光线改变时杯子形状是否保持
tools.evidence_method: Rendered browser page and expanded output FAQ
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: The free MiniMax H3 models generate five-second videos at 480p, with 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 aspect ratios.
tools.prompt_zh: 深色桌面上放着一只无品牌的白色陶瓷杯。固定镜头，让一片柔和高光从杯口左侧移到右侧，杯子始终不旋转。结束时完整显示杯子。安静摄影棚环境声，不要文字或对白。

tools.name: BestImage AI
tools.description: An image and video platform with text and two-frame routes. Useful for exploring motion between your own compositions, product arrangements or storyboard endpoints.
tools.description_zh: 适合把产品摆放、设计构图或分镜首尾状态连接起来，也能直接从文字生成场景。
tools.caution: Prepare both endpoints when using the free page’s frame-guided route.
tools.caution_zh: 使用免费页的图片引导方式时，需要准备首帧和尾帧两张图。
tools.title: Product composition shift
tools.prompt: A plain coral bottle sits on a pale stone pedestal. The camera makes a very small rightward slide while a leaf shadow moves across the background. Keep the bottle vertical, sealed and unlabelled. Finish with a still product view. Soft air movement; no speech.
tools.review: bottle proportions and stable pedestal edges
tools.evidence_method: Rendered browser page and expanded output FAQ
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: The free MiniMax H3 workflow creates five-second, 480p clips in 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1.
tools.prompt_zh: 浅色石台上立着一只无标签的珊瑚色瓶子。镜头极小幅度向右平移，背景上的树叶影子缓慢移动。瓶子保持竖直、封口和固定比例。最后停在清楚的产品画面。轻微空气流动声，不要对白。

tools.name: Flyne AI
tools.description: A browser route for compact product-motion and graphic concepts. Try a single reveal or movement from a brief or endpoint pair, then review the resulting composition.
tools.description_zh: 适合简短的产品运动和图形创意。用文字或首尾图测试一次揭示、移动，再检查构图。
tools.caution: Keep the free request to one five-second event.
tools.caution_zh: 免费版只安排一个能在 5 秒内看清的动作。
tools.title: Colorful product reveal
tools.prompt: A lavender fabric panel slides sideways to reveal an unbranded mint-green portable speaker on a white cube. Fixed frontal camera. Keep all speaker holes and edges consistent. Leave a clear final product hold. A soft fabric rustle, no text or dialogue.
tools.review: fabric separation and stable product holes
tools.review_zh: 布料与产品是否分离、孔位是否稳定
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: The free output is 480p and 5 seconds.
tools.prompt_zh: 一块淡紫色布帘向侧面滑开，露出白色方台上的无品牌薄荷绿便携音箱。固定正面镜头，音箱孔位和边缘保持不变。结尾停留展示产品。轻微布料摩擦声，不要文字或对白。

tools.name: SeaImagine
tools.description: A visual exploration entry point for imagined architecture, surreal compositions and atmosphere. One restrained movement helps assess scale and lighting.
tools.description_zh: 适合想象建筑、超现实构图和空间氛围。用一个克制的动作观察尺度、透视和光影。
tools.caution: An architectural concept is not a construction or property record.
tools.caution_zh: 建筑概念画面不能作为真实房产或施工记录。
tools.title: Atrium light study
tools.prompt: A quiet circular atrium has pale stone walls and a shallow reflecting pool. In one locked wide shot, a soft cloud shadow passes over the water and fades. Preserve every column and reflection boundary. Gentle water ambience; no people or text.
tools.review_zh: 柱体连续性和倒影是否合理
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: The selected shape does not change the free output settings of 480p and 5 seconds.
tools.prompt_zh: 安静的圆形中庭有浅色石墙和浅倒影池。固定广角镜头，一片柔和云影掠过水面后消散。所有柱体和倒影边界保持连续。轻微水声，不要人物或文字。

tools.name: SeeVido
tools.description: A short-video entry point for a character reaction or product reveal. Build a compact story around one visible event rather than several scene changes.
tools.description_zh: 适合角色反应和产品短场景。围绕一个可见事件建立小故事，比连续塞入多个转场更容易判断结果。
tools.caution: Character identity still needs frame-by-frame review.
tools.caution_zh: 角色身份是否一致仍需逐帧检查。
tools.title: Explorer reaction
tools.prompt: A small original clay explorer stands beside a softly glowing blue pebble. The explorer leans closer, pauses, then smiles without speaking. Fixed medium framing, warm workshop light. Keep the costume, face and number of fingers unchanged. Soft room ambience.
tools.review_zh: 面部、服装和手部是否连续
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.prompt_zh: 一个原创黏土小探险者站在微微发蓝光的石子旁。角色稍微靠近，停顿，然后微笑但不说话。固定中景、暖色工作室灯光。服装、面部和手指数目保持不变，只保留轻微环境声。

tools.name: Fylia AI
tools.description: A creative entry point for portrait motion, illustrated worlds and everyday scenes. Use a restrained gesture or environmental movement to test the tone.
tools.description_zh: 适合肖像动作、插画场景和生活片段。先用小幅动作或环境变化判断整体风格。
tools.caution: Use a consenting subject or a fictional character for portraits.
tools.caution_zh: 肖像使用已获同意的人物或虚构角色。
tools.title: Illustrated window
tools.prompt: In a hand-painted fictional kitchen, an orange cat sits beside a window. The cat slowly turns its head toward a drifting leaf outside. Locked camera, soft morning light. Preserve the painted texture, window geometry and cat markings. Light breeze, no speech or text.
tools.review_zh: 猫的花纹和插画笔触是否稳定
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: This free workflow produces a 5-second clip at 480p.
tools.prompt_zh: 手绘风格的虚构厨房中，一只橘猫坐在窗边，缓慢转头看向窗外飘过的树叶。镜头固定，晨光柔和。保持绘画笔触、窗框形状和猫的花纹。轻微风声，不要对白或文字。

tools.name: VO4
tools.description: A video concept tool for arrival shots, moving cameras and fictional environments. Specify a simple spatial path so that the take has a readable beginning and end.
tools.description_zh: 适合登场镜头、移动摄影和虚构环境。把空间路线说清楚，让镜头有明确起止。
tools.caution: A complex chase needs a longer workflow than a free five-second test.
tools.caution_zh: 复杂追逐需要更长的制作流程，不能塞进一次免费试拍。
tools.title: Rover arrival
tools.prompt: A small unbranded wheeled rover enters a softly lit hangar from the left and stops on a floor marker. The camera tracks alongside at a steady walking pace, then stops with it. Preserve wheel contact, rover shape and floor lines. Quiet motor hum, no dialogue or text.
tools.review: wheel contact, tracking speed and final stop
tools.review_zh: 车轮接地、跟拍速度和最终停止
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: Work within the free clip's fixed 5 seconds and 480p resolution when planning the action.
tools.prompt_zh: 一辆无品牌小探测车从左侧驶入柔和照明的机库，在地面标记处停下。镜头以稳定步行速度平行跟拍，再和车一起停止。车轮始终接地，车身和地面线条不变。轻微电机声，不要对白或文字。

tools.name: Chat4o AI
tools.description: A text-led entry point for simple learning scenes and presentation ideas. Use one clear action to make an abstract explanation easier to discuss.
tools.description_zh: 适合教学场景和演示文稿创意。用一个清楚的动作表达概念，再补充必要文字说明。
tools.caution: Generated diagrams and science scenes need factual checking.
tools.caution_zh: 生成的示意图和科学场景仍需核对事实。
tools.title: Seed dispersal concept
tools.prompt: A close view of a dry dandelion seed head against a simple green background. A light breeze carries a few seeds gently to the right while the camera stays still. Keep the stem rooted and the remaining seed head coherent. Soft wind, no captions or speech.
tools.review: seed structure; label it as a concept illustration
tools.review_zh: 种子结构；标为概念演示
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: The generated video lasts 5 seconds and uses 480p resolution.
tools.prompt_zh: 绿色简洁背景前，一株干燥蒲公英种子球的近景。微风将几粒种子轻轻带向右侧，镜头保持静止。茎保持固定，其余种子球形状连续。轻微风声，不要字幕或对白。

tools.name: AITryOn
tools.description: A fashion-oriented creative platform whose free H3 page supports text or two-frame clips with audio. Use it to sketch garment movement, outfit scenes and product concepts before a larger production.
tools.description_zh: 适合服装运动、穿搭场景和产品概念。免费 H3 页面可从文字或首尾两张图生成带音频短片，先看运动想法，再考虑完整制作。
tools.caution: A fashion concept does not verify garment fit, fabric behavior or a real try-on result.
tools.caution_zh: 时尚概念片不能证明真实试穿效果、版型或面料表现。
tools.title: Scarf movement study
tools.prompt: A striped scarf hangs on a plain wooden stand in a bright studio. A gentle breeze moves only the loose end, then the fabric settles. Locked camera. Preserve the stripe count, color order and stand geometry. Quiet fabric movement, no person or text.
tools.review_zh: 条纹顺序和面料连续性
tools.evidence_method: Rendered browser page and expanded output FAQ
tools.evidence_summary: Page advertises free, no signup, unlimited count; output instructions state five-second 480p clips. No completed generation test.
tools.evidence_quote: The free MiniMax H3 workflow creates five-second, 480p clips in 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1.
tools.access_note: HTTP research client returned 403; rendered browser loaded successfully and output FAQ was expanded.
tools.prompt_zh: 明亮工作室中，一条条纹围巾挂在简单的木架上。微风只带动垂下的一端，随后布料平静下来。镜头固定，条纹数量、颜色顺序和木架形状不变。轻微布料声，不要人物或文字。
